# S138 — Trim the command catalogue out of ai instructions

`slicer ai instructions` should stay one command, but its "Implement one slice" section carries a read-command catalogue that `--help` and `docs/agents.md` already cover.

**Findings:** S127 review: ai instructions length, owner question · **Size:**  · **Tree:** slicer

**Not in this slice:**

## Why

The owner asked whether `ai instructions` is too long and whether more `ai` subcommands would help. Measured on main after S127: `ai instructions` is 87 lines / 858 words (~1.4k tokens), `ai skill` is ~330 words, and `docs/agents.md` is ~4.5k words. The three-tier split (short skill, quick start, full reference) already exists, so more subcommands would make an agent guess which one to call, cost extra round trips, and add texts to keep in sync. The size is not the problem; the imbalance is. "Implement one slice" is 431 of the 858 words, and its last paragraph is a dense catalogue of read commands (`list --json` ordering, `list --sort score`, `stats`, `log`, `show --section`, `show --context`) that duplicates `slicer --help` and the agent reference.

## Files

- `src/slicer/ai.py` (`INSTRUCTIONS`; `LOOP`, `EXITS` and `SPEC_GAP` are shared with `ai skill` and stay as they are)
- `tests/test_ai.py`
- `skills/slicer/SKILL.md` only if the shared loop text changes (it should not)

## Failing tests

1. The existing `tests/test_ai.py` guarantees still hold: the one-call `next --ready --section` read path, read-before-start, the targeted `show --section ... --context` example, parser-valid command examples, identical text and JSON content, and no project discovery.
2. "Implement one slice" is materially shorter than today's 431 words, with the read-command catalogue replaced by a pointer to `slicer <command> --help` and `docs/agents.md`.
3. `ai skill` output is unchanged.

## Implement

Cut the catalogue paragraph down to the reads an agent needs inside the loop (`next --ready`, `show --section --context`, `list` to check claims) and point to `--help` and the agent reference for the rest. Do not add `ai` subcommands. Do not change `LOOP`, `EXITS` or `SPEC_GAP`.

## Check

The tests above pass; the suite and `slicer check` pass.
